title: ExecutionPlan
description: Schema for a deterministic execution plan produced by the planner agent and consumed by the executor.

execution_id.description: Unique plan ID. Used for idempotency — re-running the same ID is always a no-op.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this plan was generated.

source_instruction.description: The original natural-language instruction that produced this plan. Stored verbatim for auditability.

operations.description: Ordered list of operations to apply sequentially. Each operation is independent.

summary_prompt.description: Optional instruction for the executor to produce a human-readable summary after execution.

operation_id.description: Unique ID for this operation within the plan (e.g. op_01, op_02).

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this operation does. Required for audit trail.

Filter.description: Selects which CSV rows this operation applies to. All specified conditions are ANDed. Omitting a field means match all rows for that dimension.

categories.description: Match rows whose 'category' column is in this list. Omit to match all categories.

in_stock.description: true = in-stock rows only, false = out-of-stock rows only, null or omitted = all rows.

skus.description: Match only these exact SKU values. Takes precedence over other filter fields when specified.

price_gte.description: Match rows where price >= this value.

price_lte.description: Match rows where price <= this value. Must be >= price_gte if both are specified.

Action.description: The transformation to apply to matched rows.

type.description: The kind of transformation. percent_* uses value as a percentage (e.g. 10 = 10%). fixed_* adds/subtracts an absolute amount. set_price overrides price directly. set_stock sets the in_stock boolean.

value.description: The operand for the action. Must be a number >= 0 for all price actions. Must be a boolean for set_stock.

Options.description: Optional execution controls applied after the action calculation.

round_to.description: Decimal places to round the resulting price to. Defaults to 2.

min_price.description: Price floor — resulting price will never go below this value.

max_price.description: Price ceiling — resulting price will never exceed this value.
